text: Resolved IR foundation completed: distinct stable ColumnId/ExprId/SourceId, closed LiteralValue algebra (no Any literals), runtime data type/nullability evidence on Expr, private resolved plan nodes, immutable Scan/Values SourceRef, dynamic checked column/filter/select expressions, exact typed erasure/rebinding identity, nullable comparison typing, and deterministic explain fixtures. Public construction of invalid nodes is compile-negative. Evidence: frameJVM/test and frameJS/test pass 27/27 each with identical expected plan text.
